messages:
elaine: Quick thread 11We're scheduling a cross-channel push for next Wed AM PT. Need: short X teaser, longer LinkedIn post, 30s demo clip, hero 16:9, and the lead intake flow. Can someone own the HubSpot form + webhook?
sam: I got scheduling. Plan: seed employees 30m prior, org X immediate, company LinkedIn + pinned article. Two messaging angles: "why it matters" vs "benchmarks + proof". Which platform prefers which?
matt: Video: final cut ready, will export 30s burn-captions and 1:1 for stories. Naming: launch_mini_demo_v1.mp4. Uploading to /marketing/launch/assets.
tara: I'll build the HubSpot form. Prefer direct webhook to our CRM lambda. Will add hidden fields: utm_source=social, campaign=mar_product_push. Form fields: name,email,company,role,use_case,consent. Who gets new lead pings in #sales-inbound?
elaine: Platform split: X = "why it matters" (short, bold CTAs), LinkedIn = benchmarks + short explainer. Employee seed = X teaser. Sam schedule times: employees 8:30am PT, org X 9:00am PT, LinkedIn 9:10am PT.
sam: I'll schedule and create a follow-up retarget post at +8h for warm leads. If engagement >400 interactions, trigger Wave2 with customer quote. CSV I'm using: 

platform,utc_time,variant,asset
X,2026-04-07T16:00:00Z,teaser,launch_mini_demo_v1.mp4
LinkedIn,2026-04-07T16:10:00Z,benchmarks,hero_16x9_final.png
Employee_X,2026-04-07T15:30:00Z,teaser,hero_thumb.png

matt: Assets uploaded to Drive + s3://redwood-marketing/launch/launch_mini_demo_v1.mp4. Also added story crop.
tara: Form + workflow created. HubSpot webhook posted here: https://hooks.redwood.internal/hs-launch-332. Workflow id hs_wf_332. Mapping added to CRM lambda. Monitoring first 25 leads and will post summary.
publish-bot: Draft posts created in scheduler (id:sch_99202). Previews: https://scheduler.redwood/preview/sch_99202
elaine: Copy in sheet. Two variants below, please pick tone and add micro-CTAs.

Variant X (teaser): "Ships tomorrow: demo in 30s. Faster inference, lower cost. Watch now 
Variant LinkedIn (bench): "We cut query latency 35% and cost per inference by 28% 1 breakdown + short demo."

tara: HubSpot: list 'mar_social_push', assign to SDR queue, tag 'mar_launch'. Sending notifications to #sales-inbound for lead_score>60.
sam: Times locked and calendar invites sent. Will seed employee handles and add recommended posting copy (shorten emojis for LinkedIn).
matt: Final captions exported. Uploaded SRT + MP4.
elaine: I'll coordinate engagement replies and allocate two folks for 2hr coverage after launch for replies + demo requests. React when tasks done. :rocket:
